In 2012, gross profit grew to Ushs 235bn
(US$ 93m). EBITDA (operating profit before
amortization adjusted for foreign exchange
losses) grew to Ushs 130bn (US$ 52m),
an increase of 25%
The drivers of the increased
profitability were:
• Additional capital investments
• Growth in sales units
• Strong performance against
regulatory targets
• Full recovery of direct operating
and maintenance costs
